atomicity.reason: The Claim fuses the conjecture that a delay might exist with the separately asserted status that he did not check it, so two independently truth-evaluable assertions are packaged in one Claim.

duplicates.reason: No other Claim repeats either assertion, so there is no redundant duplicate layer.
